DEBUG SKILL - QUICK REFERENCE
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

WHEN YOU SAY "DEBUG SKILL", I FOLLOW THIS 8-PHASE LOOP:

1. UNDERSTAND THE PROBLEM
   ├─ What is the user experiencing?
   ├─ Where does it happen?
   ├─ What should happen vs what actually happens?
   └─ Is it consistent or intermittent?

2. GATHER EVIDENCE
   ├─ Browser console (F12) - errors, logs
   ├─ Network tab - API requests, status codes, responses
   ├─ Application tab - storage, auth tokens
   ├─ Code investigation - grep, git log, git diff
   └─ Database queries - test data directly

3. FORM HYPOTHESIS
   List most likely causes:
   ├─ Data/Query Issue (most likely)
   ├─ Authorization/Permissions
   ├─ Initialization Order
   ├─ Conditional Logic
   ├─ Type Mismatch
   ├─ Race Condition
   └─ Caching (least likely)

4. TEST HYPOTHESIS
   ├─ Add console logs to isolate problem
   ├─ Print actual vs expected values
   ├─ Check data types
   ├─ Narrow down where it breaks
   └─ Create minimal reproduction case

5. VERIFY ROOT CAUSE
   ├─ Can you reproduce consistently?
   ├─ Does it only happen with certain data?
   ├─ Can you trace the bug through the entire flow?
   └─ Is this the actual root cause or a symptom?

6. IMPLEMENT FIX
   ├─ Make minimal, surgical changes
   ├─ Don't fix unrelated issues
   ├─ Update related functions if needed
   └─ Add comments explaining the fix

7. VALIDATE FIX
   ├─ Code validation (npm run lint)
   ├─ Manual testing (exact broken scenario)
   ├─ Test related features (didn't break anything)
   ├─ Test edge cases (empty, null, etc)
   ├─ Browser testing (no new errors)
   └─ Reload page and verify

8. LOOP UNTIL SOLVED
   ├─ Still broken? → Go back to Phase 2
   ├─ Problem solved?
   │  ├─ Update .github/ with findings
   │  ├─ Document the fix
   │  └─ Commit with detailed message
   └─ Done!

COMMON PATTERNS TO CHECK

Empty Array / No Results:
  □ Is data being fetched? (network request made?)
  □ Is response valid? (check network tab)
  □ Is filter too strict? (removing all items?)
  □ Are null checks removing valid data?

Null Pointer:
  □ Is variable defined?
  □ Is it assigned a value?
  □ Does property exist?
  □ Did you check for null/undefined?

Wrong Data Displayed:
  □ Is correct data being queried?
  □ Is correct data being filtered?
  □ Is correct data being rendered?
  □ Is cache showing old data?

Authorization Denied:
  □ Is user authenticated? (user?.id exists?)
  □ Is user authorized? (right permissions?)
  □ Is RLS policy correct?
  □ Is auth header sent?

Infinite Loop / Performance:
  □ Is useEffect dependency array correct?
  □ Is function being called repeatedly?
  □ Is state being updated in render?
  □ Is query being re-fetched too often?

TOOLS TO USE

Browser:
  • Console: errors, logs, commands
  • Network: HTTP requests, responses
  • Application: storage, cookies, cache
  • Sources: breakpoints, step through

Code Search:
  grep -n "term" src/components/File.tsx
  grep -r "term" src/

Git:
  git log --oneline -10
  git diff HEAD~1 src/file.tsx
  git blame src/file.tsx

Database:
  const { data, error } = await supabase
    .from('table').select('*').eq('id', 'x');

SUCCESS CRITERIA (PROBLEM IS SOLVED WHEN):
  ✅ Root cause identified and documented
  ✅ Fix implemented and tested
  ✅ No new errors in console
  ✅ Related features still work
  ✅ Edge cases handled
  ✅ Solution is minimal and surgical

MOST COMMON ROOT CAUSES (IN ORDER):
  1. Data/Query (45%) - wrong filter, empty, null values
  2. Initialization (20%) - using before defined, deps wrong
  3. Authorization (15%) - RLS, permissions, not authenticated
  4. Logic (10%) - if/else not working as intended
  5. Type Mismatch (5%) - null instead of object, etc
  6. Other (5%) - caching, race conditions, etc

════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
When stuck: Go back to Phase 2 - you missed something in evidence gathering
When successful: Update .github/DEBUG_SKILL.md if new patterns discovered
════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
